plugin.name: Resident Evil 0 Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logos at start-up and the save and load notices that only need OK, and go straight to the title.
HideMouseCursorAfterMs.description: Hide the mouse cursor after it hasn't moved for this many milliseconds. 0 never hides it.
DoorSkip.description: Skip the door animations between rooms.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a framed window or borderless mode. Borderless uses the desktop resolution. Restart the game after changing this option.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show health and ammunition on supported Logitech keyboards. Requires Logitech G HUB.
DisableNoise.description: Turn off the film grain of the game's noise filter.
DisableColorCorrection.description: Turn off the game's color correction.
DisableFog.description: Disables fog in supported rendering passes. Restart required.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.restarthelp: Applies the next time the game starts
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changes.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset with Left/Right, then confirm to apply. Vanilla retains the logos. Recommended and Enhanced enable logo skipping, idle cursor hiding and RGB lighting. Only Enhanced skips door transitions and turns on depth of field. Player preferences and settings shared by all presets are kept. Restore Defaults resets every setting. Vanilla and Recommended use 60 FPS; Enhanced removes the frame limit. V-Sync may still limit the rate.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause while the game window is inactive. Turn off to keep the game running in the background.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of Plugins and the settings descriptions. Auto uses English when the game language cannot be detected. Edit this in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
FPSLimit.description: Limits normal play to 30–1000 frames per second. 0 removes the limit; -1 follows the monitor refresh rate. V-Sync can impose a lower limit. Fixed-rate sequences keep their original timing.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
update.short: An update is available. Open Plugins for details.
menu.pluginshelp: Settings for this fix and other compatible plugins.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows movies inside the picture frame chosen by the game's own aspect ratio option. Fill uses the whole screen. Both keep each movie's own shape, with black bars where needed; nothing is cut off or stretched.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Native controller button pictures: Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo. Auto uses Xbox. Keyboard and mouse names stay unchanged.
SkipPressStart.description: Continue automatically from the opening Press Start or any key prompt.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the pointer inside the active game window. Release it when unfocused or while the developer overlay is open.
ClassicKeyLinks.description: Links keyboard keys as in the original games: the attack and examine keys work as one key (attack while aiming, examine otherwise) and confirm in menus, and the run key cancels in menus. The keys stay the ones set in the game's keyboard options. A key that is also the run or quick turn key isn't linked in play, so running doesn't examine.
DepthOfField.description: The depth of field blur of the console versions in cutscenes: the game's own effect, which the PC version never switches on.
